messages:
elaine-cs: quick heads-up — three onboarding customers reported a drop in semantic search recall and a handful of 5xx errors during vectorization after a parameter tweak to the embedding pipeline this morning. two of these are in trial/renewal windows. tagging eng/sre + sales for coordinated comms.

noah-eng: investigating now. early traces show a schema/shape mismatch in the feature transform stage when a downstream optim change altered padding behavior; some batched jobs get rejected, causing 500s and degraded vectors. repro on staging for specific payload sizes.

fiona-sre: opening INC-2026-321 and putting mitigation into place: route affected tenants to the legacy transform path and add a protective reject filter for malformed batches. applying routing change now.

notify-bot: Incident INC-2026-321 | priority: medium-high | status: mitigating | created_by: fiona-sre | link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-321

elaine-cs: need a concise customer note: what happened, what we're doing now, ETA window for a full fix, data safety statement, and any customer goodwill. one short paragraph per outbound email please.

noah-eng: technical summary for CS: "Cause: padding behavior change in embedding transform after an optimization tweak, leading to occasional batch rejections and malformed vectors. Mitigation: routing affected tenants to legacy transform path and rejecting malformed batches; building and validating a corrected transform artifact. ETA for validated artifact: 24-48 hours, rollback possible if needed."

mohit-legal: wording: use explicit phrase "we do not detect any customer data loss or exfiltration." avoid promising precise hours under 24. ensure outbound communications are archived per retention policy.

sam-sales: looping the AEs for the two renewal accounts. please DM per-account impact metrics (recall delta, error counts) so I can prep outreach.

elaine-cs: draft email for the three onboarding contacts below; will send after eng + legal signoff and once routing is stable for 30m.

elaine-cs: ```Hi <Customer Contact>,

We wanted to let you know we observed reduced relevance in semantic search results and intermittent 5xx errors during vectorization for a subset of bulk and streaming ingest requests following a parameter change to our embedding pipeline this morning. Our engineers identified a transform behavior regression and have routed affected workloads to a legacy transform path while we validate a corrected artifact.

We do not detect any customer data loss or exfiltration. We expect to have a validated mitigation and broader rollout within 24-48 hours; we will update you sooner if we rollback or complete the fix earlier.

As a courtesy for the disruption, we will apply a one-time account credit to impacted onboarding usage and offer a priority integration review to help tune ingest settings for your data. Reply to reserve a slot.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Support```

fiona-sre: portal status suggestion: "legacy transform routing applied for affected tenants; corrected artifact under validation; monitoring vector quality and error rates."

elaine-cs: adding renewals AE and sales. @noah-eng can you DM the per-tenant recall delta and log snippets for the two renewal trials?

noah-eng: will DM charts and sample traces in ~10m and start a PR to add a padding-shape regression test.

mohit-legal: CS, please upload sent copies to the incident archive for retention and flag regulated tenants so we can prepare a compliance note if requested.

elaine-cs: plan recap: 1) route to legacy transform (done) 2) 30m stability monitor 3) targeted emails to 3 onboarding contacts + portal post 4) credits + priority integration reviews 5) RCA and permanent fix ETA within 72 hours.

fiona-sre: stability green at 35m; expanding routing rollback. metrics look back to baseline.

elaine-cs: sending emails now. will upload sent copy + recipients to cs-incident-archive and compile renewal sentiment notes for sales. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
